name: Wyndham Rewards Earner Card

apr.notes: Variable APR is 19.24% to 29.99% for purchases and balance transfers. Variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening for the first 15 billing cycles. 0% promotional APR on all 'Wyndham Timeshare Purchases' for 6 billing cycles. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10).

fx_fee.notes: Disclosure states 'Foreign transaction fee: 0%.' Page also states 'No Foreign Transaction Fees On international purchases.'

base_rate.description: Earn 1 point per $1 spent on all other purchases (excluding Vacation Club down payments).

categories.label: Earn 5 points per $1 spent on eligible purchases made at Hotels by Wyndham, including hotels through Wyndham Travel Bundles.
Earn 3 points per $1 spent on eligible Vacation Club, dining and grocery store purchases (excluding Target and Walmart), as well as eligible gas and EV charging purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem 10% fewer Wyndham Rewards points for free nights, starting at just 6,750 points. Can redeem points for online merchandise, gift cards, experiences. Wyndham Rewards GOLD member level included.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 30,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 90 days and also earn 45,000 bonus points after spending $500 at Hotels by Wyndham in the first 180 days. Total up to 75,000 bonus points.

benefits.title: Wyndham Rewards GOLD Member Level
benefits.description: Automatically receive a Wyndham Rewards GOLD member level and enjoy perks like preferred room selection, late checkout, and more.

benefits.title: Save 15% When You Buy Points
benefits.description: Enjoy a 15% discount-or best available offer-when you purchase points with your Wyndham Rewards Earner Card.

benefits.title: Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: Receive 7,500 bonus points each anniversary year after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: Earn Free Nights Faster
benefits.description: Redeem 10% fewer Wyndham Rewards points for free nights, which means you can book free nights starting at just 6,750 points.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Cardmember Booking Discount
benefits.description: Wyndham Rewards Earner Card members can save even more on the Standard Rate for stays at participating Hotels by Wyndham and hotels in Wyndham Travel Bundles.

notes: Network is Visa (issued by Barclays Bank Delaware pursuant to a license by Visa U.S.A. Inc.); network_tier corrected from the Mastercard-package slug 'world' to the Visa 'signature' tier that this no-annual-fee Wyndham Rewards Earner Card carries. Earn rates: 5x at Hotels by Wyndham, 3x on Vacation Club/dining/grocery/gas/EV charging, 1x elsewhere. Signup bonus reflects the full 75,000-point offer (30,000 + 45,000 Hotels-by-Wyndham stay bonus).
